value.answer: This is often teething - drooling, chewing on everything and fussiness are common with it, and toddlers also just explore with their mouths. Something cold on the gums usually soothes best. Teething doesn't usually cause high fever, vomiting, diarrhea or cold symptoms.
value.triage: Call 811 if there is a fever, vomiting, poor drinking, or fussiness that drags on. Go to the ER or call 911 now if the drooling starts suddenly, or comes with trouble breathing, swallowing or speaking, choking, or a very sick-looking child.
